name: my-projects
description: My Projects: a pane beside your Claude Code chat. Pick a project folder and see its files and the chats that belong to it.

author.name: Order to Everything, LLC (The Orderly Entrepreneur)

projectsFolder.title: Projects folder
projectsFolder.description: The folder inside your main Claude folder that holds your projects. Leave blank: it uses a folder named Projects if you have one, otherwise every folder in your main folder.

extraFolders.title: Extra project folders
extraFolders.description: Other folders in your main folder that should also show as projects, separated by commas. Example: Admin, Inbox

titleCodes.title: Chat title codes
titleCodes.description: Optional. A chat already counts for a project when its title has the project's folder name. Add short codes here, like: Tech and Systems = TECH; Website = WEB, Homepage
